Need a top level maintainer due to the change to the nvidia file.
@ed@tanous.net - Can you please review the nvidia changes?
@ed@tanous.net requested we keep an upper critical in place.
Already updated the upper critical item.

Why was the critical threshold removed?

I would not expect any production part to need a non recoverable threshold, but they definitely need a critical threshold.
I have already updated the upper critical item according to the information provided by Nvidia.
@ed@tanous.net - Please weigh in on if you're ok with the "upper non critical" now being removed...  I don't know if you explicitly want 3 thresholds here or not.

After the modification, there are only two thresholds: "upper non-recoverable" and "upper critical." These two settings are based on the information provided by Nvidia. Therefore, the "upper non-critical" is required.
